skills.name: Base Strength
skills.description: Each rank: +4 sword damage and +10 maximum HP. Up to five ranks.

skills.name: Measured Force
skills.description: 30% less stamina for every light, heavy and charge thrust. Equip in a passive slot. Each extra rank strengthens this bonus by 25% of its base; three ranks maximum.

skills.name: Crushing Force
skills.description: 50% more damage for all sword strikes after base Strength bonuses. Equip in a passive slot. Each extra rank strengthens this bonus by 25% of its base; three ranks maximum.

skills.name: Base Form
skills.description: Each rank: +5% walking and sprint speed; 8% less sprint stamina. Up to five ranks.

skills.name: Driving Thrust
skills.description: Equip in Inventory: hold to charge (8 stamina/s), then release a long thrust with 2.5x knockback and a stopping wind gust.

skills.name: Dodge
skills.description: Press Ctrl or tap Shift to dive and roll, then stand up. Hold Shift to sprint. Costs 18 stamina.

skills.name: Water Slash
skills.description: Unlock the moving water slash. Equip on Q in Inventory. Costs 24 stamina.

skills.name: Water Lance
skills.description: Unlock the three-second charged beam. Equip on Q in Inventory. Damage interrupts charging.

skills.name: Flowing Splash
skills.description: Unlocks an automatic mana slash after a dash swing. Equip this passive for 60% less Water Slash stamina (24 to 9.6). Each extra rank strengthens the saving by 25% of its base; three ranks maximum.

skills.name: Opening Cut
skills.description: Each rank: +15% opening light-cut damage. Three ranks.

skills.name: Return Cut
skills.description: Each rank: +15% second combo slash damage. Three ranks.

skills.name: Spin & Slam
skills.description: Each rank: +15% third combo attack damage. Three ranks.

skills.name: Heavy Impact
skills.description: Each rank: +15% overhead-heavy damage. Three ranks.

skills.name: Thrust Power
skills.description: Each rank: +15% Driving Thrust damage. Three ranks.

skills.name: Thrust Control
skills.description: Each rank: 15% faster charge buildup and 15% less windup, extended hold and recovery time. Three ranks.

skills.name: Dash
skills.description: Hold T to build distance, release to dash (2.5-7m; 12-24 stamina). With sword drawn, left-click or J while holding T queues an opening swing at the dash exit, costing normal swing stamina. No invulnerability.

skills.name: Dash Reach
skills.description: Each rank: +25% distance for every Dash, from a quick T press to a full charge. Three ranks; +75% maximum. Charge time and stamina cost stay the same.

skills.name: Jump
skills.description: Press Space for a short jump while moving. Costs 12 stamina; no invulnerability.

skills.name: Water Slash Power
skills.description: Each rank: +15% Water Slash damage. Three ranks.

skills.name: Lance Power
skills.description: Each rank: +15% Water Lance damage. Three ranks.

skills.name: Lance Control
skills.description: Each rank: 25% less Water Lance aim kick and 15% shorter charge. Three ranks; up to 75% steadier control.

skills.name: Stamina Capacity
skills.description: Each rank: +10 maximum stamina. Five ranks.
